title: Sicilian-Style Tuna Pasta
summary: A classic Sicilian combination showcasing bold, briny flavours. Anchovies melt into the sauce adding depth without fishiness.

items.item: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring large pot of salted water to boil for pasta.
Heat olive oil in large pan over medium heat. Add chopped onion, cook 5-7 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add anchovy fillets to pan. Mash with wooden spoon until dissolved into oil (1-2 minutes).
Add sliced garlic, cook until just golden (1 minute). Watch carefully so it does not burn.
Add olives, capers, and chili (if using). Stir and cook 1-2 minutes to combine flavours.
If using wine, add now and let bubble for 1 minute until slightly reduced.
Add tuna with its oil, breaking up gently. Do not over-mix - keep some chunks. Cook 2-3 minutes to warm through.
Cook pasta until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Add drained pasta to pan with tuna mixture. Add pasta water gradually (start with 3-4 tbsp), tossing until glossy and well-coated.
Remove from heat, add chopped parsley and black pepper. Taste - may not need additional salt. Serve immediately. No cheese.

tips: If your tuna is in good olive oil (Italian/Spanish brands), use that oil - reduce starting oil accordingly. Casarecce's twisted shape perfectly catches the chunky bits. Use parsley or basil - never rosemary or thyme which overpower delicate tuna.
